data "aws_caller_identity" "current" {}

# Role and Permission Definition
data "aws_iam_policy_document" "permission-policy-doc" {
  
  # Bloque 1: Permisos de lectura (Necesarios para usar la Consola/CLI)
  statement {
    sid       = "AllowDescribeActions"
    actions   = ["ec2:Describe*"]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  # Bloque 2: Restricciones específicas al crear la INSTANCIA
  statement {
    sid       = "AllowRunInstancesWithLimits"
    actions   = ["ec2:RunInstances"]
    resources = ["arn:aws:ec2:*:*:instance/*"] # Aplicado específicamente al recurso instancia

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "ec2:InstanceType"
      values   = ["t2.micro", "t3.micro"]
    }

    condition {
      test     = "Null"
      variable = "aws:RequestTag/Environment"
      values   = ["false"] # Significa: El tag "Environment" NO debe ser nulo (debe existir)
    }
  }

  # Bloque 3: Permitir el uso de recursos auxiliares para la creación
  statement {
    sid       = "AllowRequiredResources"
    actions   = ["ec2:RunInstances"]
    resources = [
      "arn:aws:ec2:*:*:volume/*",
      "arn:aws:ec2:*:*:network-interface/*",
      "arn:aws:ec2:*:*:key-pair/*",
      "arn:aws:ec2:*::image/*",
      "arn:aws:ec2:*:*:security-group/*",
      "arn:aws:ec2:*:*:subnet/*"
    ]
  }

  # Bloque 4: Obligatorio si pides tags al crear
  # Esta politica permite al usuario que pueda asignar una tag 
  # siempre que solo se trate de una operacion ec2:CreateAction
  statement {
    sid       = "AllowCreateTagsOnLaunch"
    actions   = ["ec2:CreateTags"]
    resources = ["arn:aws:ec2:*:*:*"]
    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "ec2:CreateAction"
      values   = ["RunInstances"]
    }
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "policy" {
  name   = "AllowRunOnlyLowCostInstancePolicy"
  policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.permission-policy-doc.json
}

resource "aws_iam_user" "example_user" {
  name = "example-user"
}

resource "aws_iam_user_policy_attachment" "user_policy_attach" {
  user       = aws_iam_user.example_user.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.policy.arn
}
